$comment: Vanilla character-creation options. Values are the exact strings the game stores in the .fch (prefab/hair/beard identifiers; the menus resolve them from ObjectDB). Curated from shipped 1.0.x options and confirmed against real saves (Hair4, Hair18, BeardNone observed). Extend this file for modded content — BodyForge writes whatever string the palette provides; unknown names simply display as default in-game.
